summary: The MaintStudent module is responsible for managing student data within the system, including CRUD operations, validation, and interaction with associated entities like departments and consent programs.
purpose: To manage student data efficiently, including creating, editing, and validating student records while ensuring proper permissions and data integrity within the system.

workflows.name: Add New Student
steps: If no duplicates, add new student.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can edit student numbers.
Consent Program fields are hidden for non-admin users if consent already exists.

validations.name: validSearchCriteria
validations.description: Ensures some criteria are entered for searching.

validations.name: checkStudentNumberTemplate
validations.description: Validates student number against a template.

conditions.name: ConsentExpiration
conditions.description: Checks if consent is expired or expiring soon.

system_behavior: Displays a warning if consent is expired.
Hides sensitive fields based on user role.
dependencies: DropDownList for selecting programs and agencies
exceptions: DuplicateNameException: Triggered when a duplicate name is detected.
TemplateMismatchException: Triggered when student number doesn't match template.
content_gaps: Incomplete details about the complete list of fields and validations.
